description: SideBar sub-item — a submenu row inside the expanded sidebar. md-squared vertically (height 32/44/52), no icon, and the leading inset is DERIVED, not authored: the sub-item's label aligns with its parent item's label, so the indent = the parent's inset + the icon's cap cell + the icon gap (32/40/46 across densities). Same ghost ladder, same accent selected, same thin underline separator as the parent item.
notes: v0.1.0 (2026-09-05, Victor's sidebar review): the early mock said 48 — but that mock's icon occupies its full glyph box in flow; ours occupies the cap cell, so the SAME alignment rule ('sub label aligns with parent label') measures 40 at comfortable. The indent is a resolved fact: it recomputes if the parent's inset, the cap, or the icon gap ever change. Collapsed sub-items do not exist — a collapsed sidebar's submenu is the floating Menu (composition). v0.2.0: Label ink nudged strong → SUBTLE (2026-09-05, Victor — 'will look better'): menu labels are SCANNED (md compressed), floor Lc 60; measured live via apca-w3: subtle at rest = 84.7 light / −86.1 dark on surface, −69.1 on the dark floating panel (the tightest real case, above the floor); hover 67/−69. Selected keeps text-accent-strong — the 60.4 corner never occurs. Accepted trade: label and icon now share step 12, flattening the strong-text/subtle-icon hierarchy for nav rows — quieter chrome, deliberate.
